responsibility: Provides the concrete compression and decompression engine used for LTO intermediate-language sections. It implements buffered lto_compression_stream objects, accumulates section bytes, and on finalization compresses or uncompresses them through zlib or zstd, normalizing command-line compression levels, invoking client callbacks with the transformed data, updating LTO byte-count statistics, and timing the work. This file is the runtime implementation behind compressed LTO section I/O rather than section naming or higher-level streamer logic.
same_name_distinction: Implements the lto-compress interface declared in gcc/lto-compress.h: it defines the private lto_compression_stream object and performs the actual buffered zlib/zstd compression and decompression work, including level normalization, callbacks, timing, and byte-count accounting.
